note: Single source for routing. work-router/SKILL.md lists the same skills; scripts/route_work.py reads this file; verify_pack.py fails if they drift. Add a skill = add one row here.

modes.LIGHT: Answer or act directly. No state files, no extra skills.
modes.CHECKPOINTED: Independent units with durable receipts; resume from verified evidence.
modes.COORDINATED: Several writers or an external/irreversible effect; exclusive ownership and live preconditions.

routes.when: Interrupted, resumed or handed-off work; state files exist.
Slow, fragile or repeatedly interrupted test suites.
Multi-step outcome without acceptance criteria, or scope changed mid-work.
External facts, tool comparison, provenance or mirror questions.
Failure with unknown cause, intermittent, or a fix already failed.
Several agents, branches or sessions share files, locks or tasks.
A proposed change must be accepted, rejected or merged.
Push, merge, deploy, send, upload or delete.
Creating, changing, importing or rolling out a skill.
